name: NON_DETECT
definition: analyte reported as not detected (limit may be unknown)

name: BELOW_LOD
definition: below the stated limit of detection
numeric_use: left-censored at LOD (LOD must be stated)

name: BELOW_LOQ
definition: below the stated limit of quantification
numeric_use: left-censored at LOQ (LOQ must be stated)

name: ABOVE_CAP
definition: reported value is a cap/upper bound (e.g. >100% retention capped)

name: NOT_REPORTED
definition: no value or censoring information (UNKNOWN is not NON_DETECT)
